title: Yale’s Sonnenfeld: Nvidia is a ‘detriment’ to US industrial might — not a champion
lede: Yale's Jeffrey Sonnenfeld argues Nvidia's board erred by reinstating Jensen Huang under White House pressure, and calls the company a drag on US industrial strength rather than a champion of it.

points: He says directors who backed Huang's return face historic personal liability, citing a weak D&O policy and a thin outside investigation.
Five shareholder suits have been filed in Northern California, including a derivative suit against the directors; he expects around 30.
Nvidia also faces a DOJ antitrust probe, a reported SEC probe, a California subpoena and several congressional inquiries.
Sonnenfeld claims advanced Nvidia chips reached China's military and helped Chinese labs distill Anthropic models; Nvidia denies its top chips were smuggled.
He argues the GPU and CUDA work came from others at Nvidia, such as Chris Malachowsky and Ian Buck, not Huang.
